57:19.text: Allâh and His Messengers - they are the Siddiqûn
(i.e. those followers of the Prophets who were first and foremost to believe in them)
, and the martyrs with their Lord, they shall have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
- they shall be the dwellers of the blazing Fire.

57:20.text: Know that the life of this world is only play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children.
as the likeness of vegetation after rain, thereof the growth is pleasing to the tiller; afterwards it dries up and you see it turning yellow; then it becomes straw. But in the Hereafter
. And the life of this world is only a deceiving enjoyment.

57:21.text: Race with one another in hastening towards forgiveness from your Lord

, and Paradise the width whereof is as the width of the heaven and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allâh and His Messengers. That is the Grace of Allâh which He bestows on whom He is pleased with. And Allâh is the Owner of Great Bounty.

57:22.text: No calamity befalls on the earth or in yourselves but it is inscribed in the Book of Decrees
before We bring it into existence. Verily, that is easy for Allâh.

57:23.text: In order that you may not grieve at the things that you fail to get, nor rejoice over that which has been given to you. And Allâh likes not prideful boasters.

57:24.text: Those who are misers and enjoin upon people miserliness -
(Allâh is not in need of their charity)
